chunks: They are those who bought the life of the world at the cost of the life to come; and neither will their torment decrease nor help reach them.

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter / the life to come

ai.seo_question: Who are those who 'bought' the worldly life at the cost of the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the hypocrites (Munafiqun) and those who prioritized worldly gain over spiritual integrity, reflecting the concept of 'buying' the transient for the eternal. The phrase 'nor will they be helped' underscores the finality of their choice, indicating that divine aid is reserved for those who remain steadfast in faith and piety.
